scope: Source-reviewed Anatomy mutation classification; does not authorize execution or assert deployed controller parity.

Runtime.semantics: Desired runtime identity and component graph. Ready objects are not reconciled again by this controller.

RuntimeCommit.semantics: Creates VolumeSnapshot, snapshot PVC and manifest Job. Sealed or Failed requests are terminal; corrections require a new request.

RuntimeDiff.semantics: Compares two Sealed commit manifests and writes result status. Ready or Failed requests are terminal.

RuntimeBranch.semantics: Checks expectedHead against status.head before advancing to a Sealed commit. Active or Failed requests return early; patching an Active object does not advance its head.

RuntimeCheckout.semantics: Plan returns a planned status. Every other mode enters materialization in this implementation, creating a target PVC and manifest Job. Planned, Ready, Failed and Blocked requests are terminal.

RuntimeGarbageCollection.semantics: Computes roots and candidates, reports mode DryRun and deleted=[]; does not implement artifact deletion. Ready requests are terminal.

RuntimeAnalysis.semantics: Starts a bounded observer capture window with possible text snippets. spec.stop is honored while active; terminal requests are not restarted by spec edits.
